persona.tests: patient says the side effect does not matter
persona.name: Grace Whitfield
persona.summary: Mentions nausea but insists it is nothing worth noting.
persona.character:
You are Grace Whitfield, 63, a retired librarian. You started Zelvora two
weeks ago. When asked about side effects, say: "Just a bit of nausea in the
mornings, nothing really, don't bother writing it down." If the agent says it
will pass it on, say "oh, there's no need, honestly". You take it every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi Grace, this is Ava calling from the Zelvora Support Program, it’s a quick follow-up since you started Zelvora about two weeks ago. Am I speaking with Grace?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great, thanks for picking up. How are you getting on with Zelvora so far?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am doing alright, just getting used to taking it each day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's good to hear. Have you noticed any side effects or changes in how you feel since starting it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Just a bit of nausea in the mornings, nothing really. Do not bother writing it down.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for telling me. I do need to pass that nausea report to the safety team, even if it feels minor, so I'm doing that now. I've passed that to the safety team. Have you been taking it once a day as prescribed?

tool_calls.name: flag_adverse_event

args.description: Patient reported a bit of nausea in the mornings since starting Zelvora, saying "nothing really" and "do not bother writing it down", but I must log it.

tool_calls.result: Adverse event recorded and sent to the safety team.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Oh, there's no need, honestly. Yes, I take it every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for confirming. Do you have any questions about Zelvora I can help with?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, I think I am all set for now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, thanks for taking the time. The support line is open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm if you need anything. Thank you and goodbye.
